description: This file defines a static helper class 'ManageNavPages' containing constants, methods for determining navigation page states and CSS classes, and extension methods to set the active page in the view context for an ASP.NET Core MVC project.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static helper class providing navigation-related properties and methods for managing active pages and navigation classes in the web application's views.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Represents the 'Index' page identifier used for navigation purposes.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Represents the 'ChangePassword' page identifier used for navigation purposes.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Represents the 'ExternalLogins' page identifier used for navigation purposes.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Represents the 'TwoFactorAuthentication' page identifier used for navigation purposes.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class ('active' or '') for the Index page navigation item based on the current view context.

methods.name: ChangePasswordNavClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class ('active' or '') for the ChangePassword page navigation item based on the current view context.

methods.name: ExternalLoginsNavClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class ('active' or '') for the ExternalLogins page navigation item based on the current view context.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationNavClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class ('active' or '') for the TwoFactorAuthentication page navigation item based on the current view context.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' CSS class if the given page matches the active page in the view context, otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: Extension method that sets the active page in a ViewDataDictionary object for navigation highlighting.
